centre.about_html:
Community Counselling and Resource Centre is a Non-Profit rehab that provides comprehensive mental health treatment services. Located in Peterborough, Ontario, this facility is committed to helping individuals overcome mental health challenges and substance abuse issues through evidence-based practices, holistic therapies, and personalized counseling.

The Community Counselling and Resource Centre specializes in the treatment of mental health issues and offers a range of therapies to address the unique needs of each individual. These include holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga and meditation, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

The center’s amenities include 12 Step Programs and outpatient drug rehab programs to ensure that individuals receive the appropriate level of care and support. These programs are designed to help individuals achieve and maintain long-term sobriety and improve their overall mental health and well-being.

At Community Counselling and Resource Centre, individuals can find the support and resources they need to overcome their challenges and achieve a healthy, fulfilling life. The center’s dedicated team of professionals is committed to providing compassionate care and support to all individuals seeking their services.

Community Counselling And Resource Centre - Center Overview

CCRC (Community Counselling and Resource Centre) has been providing professional and caring services to the community of Peterborough City and County since 1956. Their mission is to offer counselling, support, and resources to individuals to improve personal well-being, housing stability, and connection with the community.

CCRC understands that challenges can affect people’s lives in various ways and have multiple layers. Hence, their core services are designed to work collaboratively with each other and partner organizations to provide individuals with the necessary help they need.

Their commitment to making a positive and lasting difference in people’s lives and the community is evident in the services they offer. CCRC is a group of caring individuals who are dedicated to improving the lives of those living or working in Peterborough City and County.

raw_html:
Community Counselling and Resource Centre is a Non-Profit rehab that provides comprehensive mental health treatment services. Located in Peterborough, Ontario, this facility is committed to helping individuals overcome mental health challenges and substance abuse issues through evidence-based practices, holistic therapies, and personalized counseling.

The Community Counselling and Resource Centre specializes in the treatment of mental health issues and offers a range of therapies to address the unique needs of each individual. These include holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga and meditation, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

The center’s amenities include 12 Step Programs and outpatient drug rehab programs to ensure that individuals receive the appropriate level of care and support. These programs are designed to help individuals achieve and maintain long-term sobriety and improve their overall mental health and well-being.

At Community Counselling and Resource Centre, individuals can find the support and resources they need to overcome their challenges and achieve a healthy, fulfilling life. The center’s dedicated team of professionals is committed to providing compassionate care and support to all individuals seeking their services.

Community Counselling And Resource Centre - Center Overview

CCRC (Community Counselling and Resource Centre) has been providing professional and caring services to the community of Peterborough City and County since 1956. Their mission is to offer counselling, support, and resources to individuals to improve personal well-being, housing stability, and connection with the community.

CCRC understands that challenges can affect people’s lives in various ways and have multiple layers. Hence, their core services are designed to work collaboratively with each other and partner organizations to provide individuals with the necessary help they need.

Their commitment to making a positive and lasting difference in people’s lives and the community is evident in the services they offer. CCRC is a group of caring individuals who are dedicated to improving the lives of those living or working in Peterborough City and County.
